title: 上下文压缩究竟改变了什么

source.harness_execution: real installed CLI launched through PMA exact Capture Proxy
source.upstream: deterministic local Anthropic Messages SSE fixture

audiences: 第一次想理解 Claude Code 长会话的用户
排查上下文变化和规则丢失的 Harness 使用者
开发自有 Agent 并核对 compact 请求形态的工程师
teaching_contract.question: 执行 /compact 后，下一次模型请求中的旧历史、结构化摘要、当前输入和项目规则分别发生了什么？
teaching_contract.takeaway: Claude Code 发起独立压缩请求生成结构化摘要；后续请求不再逐条携带全部早期历史，而以摘要接续，并重新注入适用的项目规则。PMA 同时保留压缩前的 Capture，让用户可以比较 Harness 实际发送的前后两次请求。
explicit_limits: The real component under test is Claude Code CLI and its request assembly; the model replies come from a deterministic local fake upstream.
This trace demonstrates manual /compact, not automatic compaction near the context limit.
A shorter History, token drop, or cache statistic alone is not sufficient evidence of compaction.
The root CLAUDE.md appears in the post-compact request as a system-reminder classified by PMA as Harness injection; it is not the top-level Anthropic system array.
PMA observes compaction but does not trigger it. The PMA maintenance command pma compact is unrelated to Claude Code /compact.
The summary preserves selected task state, not a byte-for-byte copy of every earlier detail.

pre_compact_turns: 记录已经核对 docs/guide.md 和待办
experiment.manual_command: /compact focus on the project goal, verified files, and pending checkpoint
experiment.post_compact_question: 压缩后检查点：项目名、已核对文件和待办分别是什么？
hook_events: PreCompact with trigger manual and the custom compact instructions

facts: The real CLI produced five Anthropic Messages requests across four PMA user turns.
Request 4 is labeled 上下文压缩 (/compact) inside Turn 3 instead of becoming a separate user Turn.
Request 4 Harness contains a harness_compact item at messages[5] with the manual focus instructions.
Request 4 response is a structured summary covering Blue Lantern, README.md, docs/guide.md, and the pending comparison.

Request 5 History no longer carries the first two normal user/assistant pairs verbatim; it starts with a continuation summary, retains the most recent assistant message, then includes the local compact command and current question.
Request 5 Harness contains the root CLAUDE.md as messages[0].system-reminder[0].
The deterministic Request 5 response includes ROOT_RULE_RELOADED, proving the fixture received and used the re-injected rule.
PMA still displays Requests 1 through 4 after compaction because they are preserved capture evidence, not the context being resent in Request 5.

production.audio: not_started; handled by the separate voice-tuning workflow

privacy.paths: Only generic /private/tmp paths for a disposable public demo workspace; no user home directory appears.
privacy.system_prompt: The raw capture remains local and ignored. Published frames focus on PMA classifications and a fictional project rule.
privacy.headers: Authorization and session headers are visibly redacted by PMA.

visual_review.raw_frame_result: passed for composition and readability at 2048x1056
visual_review.storyboard_result: passed 15 progressive states at 1920x1080 and the same 15 states at 1024x576

review_frames.desktop: recording/review-1920/; 15 JPEG frames at 1920x1080 plus contact-sheet.jpg
review_frames.compact: recording/review-1024/; 15 JPEG frames at 1024x576 plus contact-sheet.jpg

notes: The overview focus was narrowed to the Request 4 label and compact prompt so the subtitle does not cover the teaching target.
The compact Harness arrow and text pill were removed after review showed that they covered adjacent evidence without improving direction.
Right-pane badges were moved into the divider whitespace and no longer cover section headings.
The post-compact History subtitle is temporarily raised to 10.5 percent so the current question remains readable.
Browser screenshots were stored with the .jpg extension matching their actual JPEG byte format.

The earlier nine-frame review only preserved one completed state per scene. The v0.2 review adds separate click, first-focus, and comparison states so the annotation order can be reproduced instead of inferred from a fully annotated frame.

In the four comparison scenes, marker 1 appears first and becomes visibly secondary through dim_ms when marker 2 appears; both remain only because the explanation requires a level, composition, cause, or evidence comparison.
annotation_policy: Numbered annotations appear in teaching order, never all at scene entry.
A previous marker remains only when the next explanation depends on a visible comparison or causal relation.
Source-to-detail transitions use a short click pulse or crossfade instead of keeping redundant markers.
No routed arrow remains in v0.2; click pulses, focus outlines, and numbered badges already establish every relationship without crossing readable evidence.

remaining: Freeze narration only after the owner reviews the Chinese story.
Do not publish the ignored raw request log or generated video from the main repository.
